newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BMG Australia buys rooArt records.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BMG Australia buys rooArt records.

text.p: BMG Australia, a unit of German media and entertainment group Bertelsmann AG, said on Tuesday it bought Australian independent music labels rooArt and LaDigue Recordings for an undisclosed sum.
"Taking over rooArt and its labels confirms BMG as a major player in Australian music," BMG Australian managing director James Glicker said in a statement.
RooArt musicians and groups include Wendy Matthews and You Am I.
"We are also very excited with the international potential of this collection of great talent," Glicker said.
BMG Australia is part of BMG Entertainment, which represents more than 200 labels in 42 countries, including RCA and Arista.
BMG Australia bought rooArt from its founder Chris Murphy, the former manager of Australian rock group INXS.
Murphy through his family company MMA Communications has interests in radio and music publishing.
"MMA Communications will continue to build our media and music publishing business and other diverse interests," Murphy said in the joint statement with BMG Australia.
